repos_data.description: An email and SMTP testing tool with API for developers

MCP server that lets Claude Code, Cursor and other agents check the emails they write: preview, analyze, audit, fix and diff HTML, React Email, MJML and Maizzle across 21 email clients. Local tools run offline; screenshots and share links use emailens.dev.
MCP server for email deliverability testing across 9 providers. Test inbox placement (Inbox vs Spam vs Promotions) with SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf.
Official MailFlat SDKs for Python, TypeScript/JavaScript and Java. Real email inboxes your agent or test suite can create from code and read one-time codes from.
MCP server for ZeroDrop — gives AI agents disposable inboxes with auto-extracted OTPs and magic links. Claude, Cursor, Claude Code.
